note: From the live Qdrant store and the mem0_history docker volume after the run. The Qdrant collection is dedicated to this run; the history/messages tables live in the shared mem0_history volume and are filtered to this run.

history_db.history_row_meaning: one ADD row per stored memory: (memory_id, old_memory=null, new_memory=<fact text>, event=ADD, created_at); no raw conversation
history_db.stores_raw_messages: messages table holds raw user/assistant text (role, content, session_scope=user_id) but only a bounded recent buffer (~10 rows per question), NOT the full haystack
